# Cornell University Research Guides

> A comprehensive collection of subject-specific and course-based research guides from Cornell University Library, offering curated resources, citation management tools, and information literacy instruction across disciplines.

Cornell University Research Guides (LibGuides) provides students and researchers with tailored research support across multiple disciplines including humanities, STEM, business, law, and professional studies. The guides integrate Cornell's extensive library collections (Olin, Kroch, Mann Libraries) with external databases and citation management tools to support academic success.

## Core & Getting Started

- [Home - Cornell University Research Guides](https://guides.library.cornell.edu/home): Main homepage for Cornell University Library research guides and resources

## Subject Research Guides

- [American Studies Library Research Guide](https://guides.library.cornell.edu/AmericanStudies): Subject research guide for American Studies with citations and information literacy
- [Gender, Medicine, and Body in East Asian History](https://guides.library.cornell.edu/Gender_Medicine_Body_East_Asian_History): Research guide on gender, medicine, and body in East Asian history with databases
- [Hip Hop and the Poetics of Liberation](https://guides.library.cornell.edu/hiphopliberation): Research guide on hip-hop studies with search tutorials and citation management
- [Darfur Crisis: A Selected Bibliography](https://guides.library.cornell.edu/darfur): Research guide on Darfur Crisis with curated bibliography and genocide resources

## Course-Specific Guides

- [COML 1105.105: Books With Big Ideas: Worldbending (Spring 2023)](https://guides.library.cornell.edu/complit1105ac): Course guide for Comparative Literature 1105 with research and citation resources
- [BEE 2600: Principles of Biological Engineering](https://guides.library.cornell.edu/BEE2600): Course guide for Biological Engineering 2600 with research skills and resources
- [HADM 1102: Entrepreneurship and Concept Development in the Food and Beverage Industry](https://guides.library.cornell.edu/HADM1102): Course guide for Hotel Administration 1102 on food/beverage entrepreneurship
- [HIST 1200: Designing a New World: The History of Planning and Urbanism in the Americas (Spring 2025)](https://guides.library.cornell.edu/hist1200nn): Course guide for History 1200 on urbanism and planning history in Americas
- [ILRGL 2050: Labor Relations](https://guides.library.cornell.edu/ILRGL2050fall2024): Course guide for Labor Relations with arbitration cases and labor law resources

## Professional & Career Development

- [Career Guide: Tips for MBAs](https://guides.library.cornell.edu/jobs): Career planning guide for Cornell MBA students with job search strategies
- [Corporate and Securities Law](https://guides.library.cornell.edu/corporate_securities_law): Law research guide on corporate and securities law with study aids and treatises

## Research Skills & Citation

- [Cómo Preparar una Bibliografía Anotada](https://guides.library.cornell.edu/bibliografia_anotada): Spanish-language guide to preparing annotated bibliographies with MLA/APA styles
- [Images: a guide to finding visual resources](https://guides.library.cornell.edu/findimages): Guide to finding and using visual resources, images, and copyright information

## Optional - Specialized Collections

- [American Literary Magazines In Olin Library](https://guides.library.cornell.edu/litmag): Directory of American literary magazines and poetry journals in Cornell collections
- [Fiber Science & Apparel Design Resources](https://guides.library.cornell.edu/FiberScience_ApparelDesignResources): Research guide for Fiber Science and Apparel Design with library resources
